note: Request parameters per production route. Legacy routes use settings that were valid on their models but break on the successors (see the model migration guide).

legacy_pricing.note: USD per 1M tokens for models not in the shared pricing table (from the migration guide: Sonnet 5 prices equal Sonnet 5.5; Haiku 4.5 is $1/$5).

rules.message: Update the model id to the target (exact id, no date suffix)
thinking {type: disabled} returns 400 on Sonnet 5.5 - use adaptive thinking at low effort (between_tools only if thinking must stay off)
Forced tool_choice returns 400 - use auto + strict tool schemas, steer in the prompt and check that the call happened (or use structured outputs)
Effort levels are recalibrated on Sonnet 5.5 - re-run the effort sweep against the eval suite
Manual thinking budgets return 400 on Haiku 5.5 - adaptive thinking only, depth via effort
Non-default sampling parameters return 400 on Haiku 5.5 - remove temperature/top_p/top_k
Assistant prefill returns 400 on Haiku 5.5 - use structured outputs (output_config.format)
The same text counts as about 30% more tokens - re-baseline cost (the per-token price is much lower)
Run the regression eval against the frozen baseline before switching; re-baseline latency and cost
